description: List a product model's catalog with stock and variant info (onHand/reserved/available per record and variant). A product is a record of a model whose product capability is enabled (get_model shows `product.enabled` and the field roles): create one with create_record on that model and change it with update_record; set_product_tiers and the bulk_* product tools work on the same records.

modelId.description: The product model's id or slug (from list_models)
